jobs.description:
Job description Electrical engineer
• Develops a range of electrical engineering deliverables, including specifications, calculations, reports, technical requisitions, material requisitions and others.
• Administer the packages of the electrical engineering group.
• Uses technical knowledge to perform engineering assignments and produce a range of electrical engineering deliverables (including more complex tasks) with limited guidance and direction from more senior technical professionals.
• Ensure that Electrical Engineering activities are executed according to the project procedures, specifications and standards, good engineering practices and techniques, and any project-specific requirements.
• Supervise the day-to-day (if any) engineering interfaces between PMC core engineering group, Project Management team and the engineering teams assigned to the EPC package – includes interaction with all other specialist disciplines as required.
• Participate in design reviews and engineering changes with customer and EPC contractor as necessitated by design development and ensure core team are made aware of these.
• Participate in key customer reviews and meetings as required.
• Participate in project reviews, value engineering and value improvement workshops with customer / contractor.
• Participate in (Global) meetings and reviews.
• Input engineering procedures and work practices in conjunction with Core Electrical Lead as appropriate
• Responsible for estimating electrical discipline manhours and schedule requirements in production of deliverables, coordinates own work schedule, and prepares progress reports.
• Review vendor documentation.
• Carryout Site Surveys and develop site survey reports.
Profile:
• Bsc or Msc Degree in relevant discipline, preferably Electrical or Electronics engineering
• Minimum of 10 years’ experience in major oil / gas refinery / petrochemical projects in the capacity of senior electrical engineer with engineering contractor / PMC organization.
• Fully familiar with international codes, standards and recommended practices to be adopted during EPC phases of oil / gas projects.
• Must have the capacity to supervise and manage EPC Contractors and development of detail design deliverables.
• Must have proven ability to contribute during development of electrical system studies.
• Fluent English is a must, knowledge of French or German and Dutch is a plus.
• Experienced in the use of appropriate codes of practice, standards and relevant sections of statutory documentation.

Relocations package:
As soon as we know that a highly skilled migrant will be joining us, Relocations schedules a Teams meeting. During this call, we talk through your preferences for housing, transport, and other practical matters. We’ll also explain the process, the required documents, and the allowances provided by Nouvall. Housing From the first meeting onwards, we help you step by step to find suitable housing. We’ll try to schedule an appointment with the local municipality as soon as possible so you can register and get your BSN (social security number). 
We’ll also help you with practical matters such as opening a bank account, applying for health insurance, and arranging contracts for your utilities. To help you settle in, we’ll arrange Dutch language lessons so you can start learning the basics quickly.

Production Employee 5-Shift System Zevenaar

As a production employee in a 5-shift system in Zevenaar, you will work in a dynamic environment where no days are the same.

In this role, you are responsible for ensuring the smooth running of the production process. You start your day with a brief handover from the previous shift, after which you operate and check the machines. Throughout the day, you monitor the quality of the products and resolve any issues. You ensure that the products are packed and prepared for shipment.

You will be working at a leading manufacturing company in Zevenaar. The organization is known for its innovative approach and strong focus on quality. With a team of committed employees, they strive to deliver the best products. The work atmosphere is informal and focused on collaboration, with plenty of room for personal development. 

Requirements

- MBO/ vocational working and thinking level
- Experience in a production environment
- Forklift and reach truck certificate is a plus
- Team-oriented collaboration
- Good communication skills
- Problem-solving ability
- Knowledge of safety regulations
- Good command of Dutch or English

- Salary €17.50 per hour excluding shift allowance
- Full-time employment
- Working in a 5-shift system
- Travel allowance
- Holiday pay

jobs.occupation: Warehouse job: order picker in day shift
jobs.description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

jobs.occupation: Sales Associate - Chocolate Boutique - Bruges City Centre
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity in the heart of Bruges?

Do you want a job with real growth potential? Are you passionate about customer service and working with high-quality products?

Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you.

This renowned chocolate boutique, located in the historic centre of Bruges, specialises in premium Belgian chocolate and offers customers an authentic chocolate experience.

The shop is known for its wide selection of pralines, truffles, and other handcrafted chocolate delicacies, all made with passion and craftmanship.

We are currently looking for an enthusiastic and customer oriented Sales Associate to join their team.

Your daily responsibilities:

• Welcoming and assisting customers
• Replenishing stock and maintaining attractive product displays
• Handling payments and operating the cash register
• Providing information about the product range
• Performing accurate stock control and monitoring expire dates
• Maintaining a warm and welcoming attitude at all times

• Perfect English and basic Dutch, but willingness to learn
• Willingness to work weekends (1 day off during the weekend)
• Evening work: in July & August, closing time is 10 PM (maximum 11 closing shifts per month)
French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese are also languages we are looking for.

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
• Can work in a 2-shift system
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.

Do you like to roll up your sleeves? 

And are you looking for a flexible job that fits your lifestyle?

Then SD Worx Jobs is the right place for you

SD Worx Jobs is looking for a logistics associate for a client located in Kruisem. 

Your tasks will be as follows:

• Helping to prepare orders with a scanning system

• Packing goods

• Labelling and marking 

• Performing quality checks

• You speak and understand English.

• Preferably, you have experience as an order picker.

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - part-time or weekend work
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.

• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.

• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
